# Assets

## Generated art

Every generated image in the repo, where it came from, and its license. Nothing here is taken from Dota 2, Valve or the original Warlock Brawl repo.

All images below were generated with the Codex CLI built-in image generation (`image_gen`) from prompts written for this project, then post-processed with the scripts in `art/tools/`. License: original work generated for this project. No third-party pixels ship. One picked texture (overgrown tile top) was generated with an original-mod texture attached as a loose layout reference, which the user cleared; the original textures themselves only appear in the `art/previews/*_vs_original.png` review images.

- `art/archive/`, `art/source/`, `art/previews/` and `art/brand/` are gitignored (several hundred MB). They exist only on the machine that generated them; back them up (Git LFS or external storage) before relying on them. Brand finals are wired by copying from `art/brand/` into `public/brand/`.
- Style rules pasted into every icon prompt: `art/STYLE.md`.
- Full prompt per image: `art/prompts/`.
- Masters (raw generations, keep them): `art/source/`. Finals are derived from them by `art/tools/process_icons.py` (trim to alpha, center, 256 px and 128 px) and `art/tools/process_brand.py`.
- Every generation, picked or not, is kept in `art/archive/` (see `art/archive/INDEX.md` for why each was picked or rejected). Generators never overwrite: they write the next free `v<n>`/`c<n>`. Promote one with `art/tools/pick.sh`.
- New icon variant: `python3 art/tools/run_icons.py <id>` (prompts in `art/tools/icons.py`). New texture candidate: `art/tools/gen_texture.sh <theme/name> [ref.png]` (prompts in `art/tools/textures.py`).
- The processors need Python with pillow and numpy (`python -I art/tools/process_*.py`); `process_textures.py` also calls `cwebp`.
- Texture formats: albedo lossy WebP q90; normal (OpenGL, +Y up) and ORM (R AO, G roughness, B metalness 0) near-lossless WebP, because lossy blocks broke the seam check on these smooth maps; height 8-bit lossless WebP. All tiling maps pass a decoded wrap-seam check (edge pair <= 1.2x the interior mean, `art/tools/verify_textures.py`).

The `_vs_original` images contain the original mod's textures for comparison only: keep them out of `public/`. | Original, generated for this project |

## Character base (public/models/warlock/warlock.glb)

Customized warlock built on CC0 assets by Quaternius (https://quaternius.com), license CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain), verified in each pack's license file on 2026-10-15:

- Universal Base Characters (Standard): skeleton reference; its Superhero head was used only in the archived v1 export (v3 has no face)
- Universal Animation Library 1 and 2 (Standard): animation clips
- Modular Character Outfits - Fantasy (Standard): rig, hood, boots, gauntlets, sleeves, tunic (Male_Ranger)

Robe, mantle, cape, runes and materials are custom geometry and shaders in src/render/character.

Details (character workstream):

| Item | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| Rig + outfit parts: `Male_Ranger.gltf` (Arms, Arms_Bracer, Body, Feet_Boots, Head_Hood, Legs; Pauldron and Belts dropped) with `T_Ranger_*` and `T_Regular_Male_*` textures | Quaternius, Modular Character Outfits - Fantasy [Standard] v2.1, https://quaternius.itch.io/modular-character-outfits-fantasy | CC0 1.0 (`License_Standard.txt` in the pack) |
| Clips: Idle_Loop, Walk_Loop, Jog_Fwd_Loop, Spell_Simple_Enter / Idle_Loop / Shoot / Exit, Hit_Chest, Hit_Head, Death01 (UAL1); OverhandThrow, NinjaJump_Land, Hit_Knockback (UAL2). Retargeted by bone name (same rig): rotations for all bones, pelvis translation scaled to the outfit's leg length | Quaternius, Universal Animation Library [Standard] v3.0 and Universal Animation Library 2 [Standard], https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library, https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library-2 | CC0 1.0 (`License.txt` in each pack) |
| Archived v1 head (`Superhero_Male_FullBody.gltf`, head/neck triangles only) | Quaternius, Universal Base Characters [Standard], https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-base-characters | CC0 1.0 (`License_Standard.txt`) |

- Build: `src/render/character/pipeline/build-warlock.mjs` (gltf-transform + meshoptimizer, run from a scratch dir; header has the command). It merges the parts and clips, simplifies (v3: ~8.2k outfit tris), converts textures to WebP (Ranger base colour + normal 2048, ORM and skin 512-1024) and applies meshopt compression with one scene-wide quantization volume. Output: `public/models/warlock/warlock.glb`, about 1.0 MB, loaded with GLTFLoader + MeshoptDecoder.
- Runtime additions (code, not assets): coat, tabard, sash, underlayer, cape, mantle, bell sleeves, medallions, hood void and eyes, staff variants, all TSL materials and runes.
- Every export and progress screenshot is kept in `art/archive/models/warlock/` (gitignored): v1 (with head), v2, v2b, v3 GLBs, the all-clips catalog GLB used to pick clips, and the review screenshots.
- KayKit Adventurers (CC0) was downloaded for comparison and rejected (chibi proportions); nothing from it ships.


## Audio

Every shipped sound file. The game's sound is procedural (WebAudio synthesis in `src/audio/synth.ts`); in the default hybrid mode these CC0 recordings are layered under or into it (`src/audio/hybrid.ts`). The synth version stays as the fallback until the files load, and as the A/B option (`audio.setMode('synth')` or `?audio=synth`).

- Found with the Openverse API (`api.openverse.org/v1/audio`, license filter cc0/by, NC/ND/SA excluded); each item's license was re-checked against the API at download time. The initial 56 downloaded candidates and the two additions selected in the listening review were CC0.
- Originals (Freesound preview MP3s) and their metadata JSON: `art/archive/audio/<category>/` with `MANIFEST.md` (gitignored like the rest of `art/archive/`; back it up). Never delete variants.
- Shipped files are derived by `python3 -I art/tools/process_audio.py art/archive/audio public/audio <manifest.json>` (ffmpeg only: trim, crossfade loops, loudness / peak normalize, encode). Credits for the Credits screen: `AUDIO_CREDITS` in `src/audio/assets.ts`.
- Shipped size: 49 effect and ambience recordings, about 1.06 MB Opus + 1.13 MB AAC; a browser loads one format (about 1 MB). The Enter recording is decoded during the splash; the remaining effects load after the first gesture. Announcer recordings are listed separately below.

## Announcer voice

Announcer voice generated with ElevenLabs (text-to-speech on the user's own account; not a downloaded recording). Two voices: Maverick (default) and Daniel as the deeper "Arena" alternative (Settings > Audio > Announcer voice).

- Generated by `node art/tools/gen_announcer.mjs` (key from `$ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` / `$ELEVEN_LABS_API_KEY` or this project's `.env`; `ELEVENLABS_ENV_FILE` selects another env file; the key is never stored in outputs). Maverick: 2 takes per line, Arena: 1 take per line (33 requests in total).
- Every raw take and its `.prompt.txt` sidecar (text, voice, model, settings, date): `art/archive/audio/announcer/<voice>/` (gitignored with the rest of `art/archive/`; never delete takes). The pick per line and why: `picks.json` next to them (loudest clean delivery, clipped takes excluded).
- Processed by `python3 -I art/tools/process_announcer.py` (ffmpeg: trim, light arena space, -16 LUFS, Opus + AAC). A/B of both voices (First Blood, Double Kill, Rampage, Godlike): `art/archive/audio/announcer/ab_maverick_vs_arena.m4a`.
- Pack 2 (round flow, round and match end, the arena, occasional calls: 23 lines, `--pack 2`) is Maverick only: 2 takes for Fight!, Final Round!, Victory!, Defeat! and Shutdown!, 1 for the rest (28 requests). The Arena voice plays Maverick's file for any line it has none of (`announcerFile` in `src/audio/engine.ts`). Installed 2026-10-19: all 23 lines generated and encoded as Opus + AAC, with 28 raw takes retained. They now play through the existing announcer queue/bus alongside their HUD banners. Maverick remains the default; the existing Daniel option uses Maverick for these lines. The generator's API-key shadowing bug is fixed and covered by `node --test art/tools/gen_announcer.test.mjs`. Reproduce generation with `node art/tools/gen_announcer.mjs --voice V33LkP9pVLdcjeB2y5Na --name maverick --pack 2 --takes 1 --key-takes 2`, then `python3 -I art/tools/process_announcer.py --pack 2`; completed raw takes are skipped.
- Softer arena treatment (2026-10-19): all 34 selected Maverick takes reprocessed with a broad −2.5 dB cut around 3 kHz, gentle −1.8 dB high shelf from 6 kHz, and restrained 37–293 ms reflections. Gentle 1.6:1 compression controls sharp peaks; loudness stays at −16 LUFS with oversampled limiting and encoder headroom. Reproduce with `python3 -I art/tools/process_announcer.py --voice maverick --keep-picks`; this fails if a selected original is missing and preserves `picks.json` exactly. Daniel's own 11 files retain their prior processing. Dry/new comparisons, previous encodes and measured validation are retained under `media/trailer/teaser30/v2/voice/`.
- Round-win calls (2026-10-21), rotating in `ROUND_WIN_LINES` (`src/game/announcer.ts`): pack 5 (Well Done!, Extra Crispy!, Ashes to Ashes!, Who's Next?) and pack 6 (Thank You, Come Again!, Nothing Personal!, Thoughts and Prayers!, Closed Casket!, Friendship Ended!, Rest in Pieces!, Whoops!, Outstanding!). Pack 6 also adds Victorious!, which alternates with Victory! for the match win (`MATCH_WIN_LINES`). Maverick only, 2 takes each, same processing chain. Reproduce with `node art/tools/gen_announcer.mjs --voice V33LkP9pVLdcjeB2y5Na --name maverick --pack 5 --takes 2` (then `--pack 6`), followed by `python3 -I art/tools/process_announcer.py --pack 5` (then `--pack 6`).
- Match defeats (2026-10-22), rotating with Defeat! in `DEFEAT_LINES`: pack 7 (Sorry for Your Loss!, Better Luck Next Life!, In Loving Memory!, We'll Mail the Ashes!). Maverick only, 2 takes each, same chain; `--pack 7` for both tools.
- "Denied!" variations (2026-10-22), rotating in `DENIED_LINES` with Denied! and Close Call!: pack 8 (Not Today!, Cheated Death!). Maverick only, 2 takes each, same chain; `--pack 8` for both tools.
- Unregistered 2026-10-21 (files kept in `public/audio/announcer/`, not in `AUDIO_ASSETS`, never loaded or played): "Last Warlock Standing!" (fired at odd moments over the round-win call), pack 4, an earlier round-win set judged too earnest (Round Taken!, The Arena Is Yours!, Too Hot to Handle!, Still Standing!, Survivor!), and Nobody Left to Kill!. Unregistered 2026-10-22: Round Won!, which players hear as "Round One!".
- Credit shown in the game: "Announcer voice generated with ElevenLabs" (`AUDIO_CREDITS` in `src/audio/assets.ts`).
